repo_notes.content: Primary source rule: Prefer documentation and content coming from the repository sources (code, README, docs/, package manifests, launch/URDF/ROS msg/srv files, CI or build scripts, examples, and tests) of the component repositories included in this mono-repo. Avoid creating a wiki page based solely on the ctu-mrs.github.io folder or .gitman.yml when the same information can be corroborated by at least one other repository source (file path or commit). If other sources are unavailable, the information may still be used but clearly labelled as uncorroborated.

Do not prune: Avoid automatically dropping folders from the plan unless they are empty. If storage/size limits force omissions, prioritize launch/, msg/, or docs/. If certain folders remain undocumented after one generation run, DeepWiki should surface a short follow-up report including but not limited to a 'skipped or low-coverage folders' section with reasons (e.g., 'no README, many binary files, or exceeded token limit')

UAV system focus: Focus documentation on the UAV system architecture, runtime components, and robotics functionality. Avoid pages that primarily document the mrs_meta repository itself, its documentation system, or generic developer tooling unless they are specific to the ROS2 MRS UAV System

Output expectations: Generate pages with clear titles. Each page should include (a) a one-sentence summary, (b) source file links, (c) architecture or dependency diagrams where applicable, and (d) a 'Where to look next' section linking to the repository files and relevant pages in other repositories. When describing system architecture, components, or runtime behavior, prefer inferring structure from source code rather than relying solely on prose documentation, and include a short 'Confidence' note (low|medium|high)

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the mrs_uav_system (not mrs_meta) repository, summarizing at a high level what it contains and its purpose as a UAV control, estimation, and simulation platform

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Guide users through initial setup, from understanding repository structures to running their first simulation

pages.title: Terminology and Key Features
pages.purpose: Define key terminology and concepts used throughout the MRS UAV System and detail it's key features and capabilities, including control pipelines, state estimation, mapping, and planning

pages.title: UAV ROS API, Frames and Configuration
pages.purpose: Document how users and their own nodes interact with a running UAV: the main topics and services exposed by the MRS UAV System, reference and trajectory inputs, frames of reference and transformations, and how to override default parameters with custom config files and real-world (safety area, world origin) files

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/40-api (UAV-ROS API, ROS messages, custom configs, frames of reference, transformations, custom real world file, trajectory input), corroborated by mrs_msgs/ (msg/, srv/), mrs_uav_managers/ (control_manager, uav_manager, transform_manager, safety_area_manager, config/ defaults) and the custom_config.yaml / world_config.yaml files in the tmux/ sessions of mrs_core_examples/ and the simulator packages.

pages.title: Examples and How-to Use Cases
pages.purpose: Walk through the example packages (waypoint flier, example controller/tracker/estimator plugins, sweeping generator, computer vision examples) and common how-to use cases such as loading paths and trajectories, mid-air activation, the passthrough estimator and relative commands

page_notes.content: Sources: mrs_core_examples/ (cpp/, python/, repurpose_package.sh), mrs_computer_vision_examples/, ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/62-example-packages and ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/65-howto-usecases.

pages.title: Prerequisites
pages.purpose: Summarize the required knowledge and tools (Linux, Bash, Git, SSH, ROS2, Docker) needed to work with and develop for the MRS UAV system

pages.title: Bash Shell
pages.purpose: Document essential Bash skills including file system navigation, shell scripting, pipes, redirection, and system administration commands

pages.title: SSH Configuration
pages.purpose: Explain SSH setup for remote UAV access, including key generation, passwordless authentication, hostname configuration, and file transfer operations

pages.title: C++ and Python
pages.purpose: Programming guidelines for development in the MRS ecosystem, covering coding practices, common commands, and typical development workflows

pages.title: ROS2 Development Environment
pages.purpose: Comprehensive guide to setting up and working with ROS2 Jazzy, including installation, workspace management, and migration patterns from ROS1

pages.title: ROS2 Installation and Workspace Setup
pages.purpose: Detail the process of installing ROS2 Jazzy on Ubuntu 24.04, including Docker-based alternatives

pages.title: ROS1 to ROS2 Migration: Time, Publishers, QoS and Logging
pages.purpose: Document key patterns and changes when migrating from ROS1 to ROS2 as used in MRS code: rclcpp::Time and rclcpp::Duration, clocks and sleeping, publisher creation, Quality of Service (QoS) profiles, latched publishers with transient_local durability, and logging

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/10-prerequisites/25-ros2/50-ros1-ros2-patterns/30-cpp_working_with_time.md, 51-publishers.md, 50-logging.md, corroborated by usage in mrs_lib/ (e.g. publisher and timer wrappers) and mrs_core_examples/.

pages.title: Colcon Build System, Profiles and Mixins
pages.purpose: Explain colcon configuration using command-line arguments and YAML files, workspace-wide build settings, build profiles via colcon mixins, and custom mixin creation

pages.title: Launch Files, Parameters and Rosbags
pages.purpose: Cover ROS2 launch file structure and patterns for configuring and starting multiple nodes, ROS2 parameter configuration and runtime management (including mrs_lib's ParamLoader), and recording and converting rosbags

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/10-prerequisites/25-ros2/50-ros1-ros2-patterns/40-launch_files.md, 60-parameters.md, 65-rosbags.md, ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/120-miscellaneous/bagfile_convert_ros1_ros2.md, with real examples from the launch/ folders of the mrs_uav_* packages and mrs_lib/include/mrs_lib/param_loader.h.

pages.title: System Architecture and Package Overview
pages.purpose: Present the high-level architecture of the MRS UAV System, showing how core libraries, UAV management, control, estimation, mapping, simulation and hardware packages interact, and list every package with its role and relationships

pages.title: Core Foundation Packages
pages.purpose: Document mrs_lib, mrs_msgs, mrs_modules_msgs, and mrs_serial as the foundational libraries providing common utilities and message definitions

pages.title: UAV System Management
pages.purpose: Explain mrs_uav_system, mrs_uav_managers, mrs_uav_autostart, and mrs_uav_status for system integration, coordination, and health monitoring

pages.title: Control and Navigation Stack
pages.purpose: Detail the hierarchical control architecture including mrs_uav_controllers, mrs_uav_trackers, mrs_uav_trajectory_generation, and mrs_octomap_planner

pages.title: State Estimation Framework
pages.purpose: Cover the plugin-based state estimator framework including OpenVINS (VIO), Point-LIO (LIO), and the estimator manager for multi-sensor fusion

page_notes.content: open_vins/ (OpenVINS) and point-lio/ (Point-LIO) are forks of external algorithms. Describe them at the interface level (what they provide to the MRS UAV System, launch and configuration, and how mrs_open_vins_estimator_plugin, mrs_vins_republisher, mrs_vins_imu_filter and mrs_point_lio_estimator_plugin integrate them) rather than documenting their internal algorithms. The core of the framework is mrs_uav_state_estimators/ and the estimation manager in mrs_uav_managers/.

pages.title: Mapping and Planning
pages.purpose: Document the octomap-based 3D mapping and planning stack including mrs_octomap_server, mrs_octomap_tools, and mrs_octomap_planner

pages.title: Hardware Interfaces
pages.purpose: Describe hardware abstraction and interfaces used by MRS (serial links, sensor drivers, mavlink bridges, GPS/RTK integration), and where to find the driver code and configuration

pages.title: Sensors
pages.purpose: Document the sensors supported on MRS UAVs (Ouster and Livox lidars, Luxonis OAK, RealSense and Bluefox cameras), their drivers, launch and configuration, and how their data feeds state estimation and mapping

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/75-sensors, realsense/ (launch/, config/), sensor templates in mrs_uav_gazebo_simulator/models/mrs_robots_description/sdf/components, and ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/100-hardware/cameras.

pages.title: Simulation Packages
pages.purpose: Compare the supported simulators (MRS Multirotor Simulator, Gazebo, FlightForge) and when to use each; document in depth the MRS Multirotor Simulator and Gazebo: how to run them, spawn UAVs, configure drones, worlds and sensors, and how simulated sensors and actors map to real hardware packages

page_notes.content: Cover mrs_multirotor_simulator/ and mrs_uav_gazebo_simulator/ (launch/, config/, tmux/, models/mrs_robots_description/sdf/ jinja templates for drones and sensors) together with ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/60-simulations/01-gazebo and 10-mrs. Only summarize FlightForge here and link to the dedicated 'FlightForge Simulator' page.

pages.title: FlightForge Simulator
pages.purpose: Document the Unreal Engine 5 based FlightForge simulator: its architecture (UE5 plugin + ROS2 endpoint), available maps, installation on Linux and Windows/WSL, running it (including headless mode), simulated sensors (cameras, depth, segmentation, lidar), configuration files, example tmux sessions with the MRS UAV System, and the standalone C++/Python connector API for using it without ROS

page_notes.content: Sources: mrs_uav_flightforge_simulator/ (ROS2 endpoint and MRS HW API plugin: src/flightforge_simulator.cpp, src/hw_api_plugin.cpp, config/, launch/, tmux/one_drone/), flight_forge/ (Unreal plugin; only C++ source under FlightForgePlugin/Source is kept, the Unreal assets were removed from this mono-repo and the precompiled simulator binary is downloaded separately as described in the READMEs), mrs_flight_forge_connector/ (C++ API in include/flight_forge_connector and src/, pybind11 bindings in src/python-modules, examples/cli and examples/python including the gym-style ueds_camera_env.py / ueds_lidar_env.py environments) and ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/60-simulations/30-FlightForge. Explain the network protocol between the UE5 game (flight_forge/FlightForgePlugin/Source/ueds, MessageSerialization) and its clients. Note that mrs_uav_flightforge_simulator/ vendors a copy of the connector sources in src/flight_forge_connector and include/flight_forge_connector.

pages.title: Development and Visualization Tools
pages.purpose: List the recommended developer tools (rqt, rviz, plotting tools, logging viewers) and workflows for debugging and visualizing MRS UAV behavior

pages.title: Writing Plugins
pages.purpose: Explain the pluginlib-based extension points of the MRS UAV System and how to write custom controllers, trackers, state estimators and hardware API plugins, including the interfaces to implement, registration and configuration

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/45-plugin-interface, the plugin interfaces in mrs_uav_managers/include (controller, tracker, estimator interfaces) and mrs_uav_hw_api/, the example plugins in mrs_core_examples/cpp/example_*_plugin, and real implementations in mrs_uav_controllers/, mrs_uav_trackers/, mrs_uav_state_estimators/ and mrs_uav_px4_api/.

pages.title: Advanced Topics
pages.purpose: Collect deep-dive features that require specialized knowledge: RTK GPS integration, AMSL altitude handling, the escalating failsafe, obstacle bumper, inter-UAV collision avoidance, precise landing and multi-robot networking over Zenoh

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/50-features (56-escalating-failsafe, 58-obstacle-bumper, 59-inter-uav-collision-avoidance, 60-precise-landing, 100-zenoh-network), ctu-mrs.github.io/blog/2024/12-18-accurate-amsl-altitude.md, corroborated by mrs_uav_managers/ and mrs_uav_state_estimators/.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Explain how to deploy the MRS UAV System on a real UAV or workstation: native installation, Docker (and why it is used for reproducible development and deployment), Apptainer, Podman, Kubernetes and Portainer, plus preparing for a real-world experiment

page_notes.content: Sources: ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/70-deployment, ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/20-installation, ctu-mrs.github.io/docs/10-prerequisites/30-docker, mrs_docker/ (deployment/ros2, recipes/) and mrs_apptainer/.

pages.title: Building Docker Images
pages.purpose: Describe how to build MRS Docker images locally, how CI builds images, and how to customize image contents

pages.title: Docker FAQ
pages.purpose: Collect common Docker issues and solutions encountered when running MRS images (permissions, display forwarding, X11, GPU access, networking)
